description: This file defines utility functions for synchronizing and persisting JSON settings to a file, including file operations and JSON object manipulation within the Utils namespace.

methods.name: syncPersistFile
methods.description: Synchronizes a file by opening it, flushing buffers, syncing to disk, and closing.

methods.name: persistJsonSettings
methods.description: Persists a JSON value to a file with a specific key, updating the JSON object in the file and ensuring data is synchronized to disk.
